verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/. The endpoint reference covers conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics, with per-endpoint example requests, documented rate limits with 429/Retry-After headers, and inline breaking-change notes. API access is listed as a plan feature, and drafts can be created through the API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), a formal versioning/deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
